source_caveats: Original exercise context retains the introductory finite graph setting. Select only the second claim, a tree possibly with loops. Solution 2 is excluded.

Original p620 writes E_y[(1+s)^{τ_y^+}]=E_x[(1+s)^{1+τ_y}] and then uses 1+sum of excursions for the return time. Keep the original printing. The displayed positive return and the hitting-time excursion normalization differ by the unit 1+s, which does not change the integral coefficient mechanism.
